vocabulary.meaning_en: talk with a client to agree on business terms
vocabulary.example: Anna negotiated a deal with a French client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: negotiate again to change an agreement
vocabulary.example: We need to renegotiate the contract.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good quality for the price you pay
vocabulary.example: Our products are good value for money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be proud of a quality you have
vocabulary.example: We pride ourselves on fast delivery.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a customer who is important to the company
vocabulary.example: You are a valued customer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: offer the same price as another company
vocabulary.example: We can match the price of our competitors.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a company that sells the same things as you
vocabulary.example: Our competitor offered a lower price.

vocabulary.meaning_en: offer a better (lower) price than someone
vocabulary.example: We can beat their price by 5%.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sell at a lower price than a competitor
vocabulary.example: They tried to undercut our price.

vocabulary.meaning_en: numbers, especially prices or sales results
vocabulary.note_ar: figure لها معنى آخر: شكل الجسم
vocabulary.note_en: Figure can also mean body shape.
vocabulary.example: Can you work out some new figures?

vocabulary.meaning_en: working out numbers with maths
vocabulary.example: I've done some calculations.

vocabulary.meaning_en: calculate or find the answer
vocabulary.example: Let's work out the total cost.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money you earn after costs
vocabulary.example: Less profit is better than no profit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: say something is true (without proof)
vocabulary.example: The client claims they paid too much.

vocabulary.meaning_en: shown for people to see
vocabulary.example: The new lemons are on display in the shop window.

vocabulary.meaning_en: buy or take something quickly before others
vocabulary.example: Please decide soon before someone else snaps up this offer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult and needing care
vocabulary.example: This is a tricky sales deal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: finish an agreement successfully
vocabulary.example: We need to fly to France and seal the deal.

vocabulary.meaning_en: be successful after effort
vocabulary.example: Her hard work paid off.

vocabulary.meaning_en: take time to think about something (British, informal)
vocabulary.example: I'll have a think and call you tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: match vs beat (a price)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: match the price تعني نقدّم السعر نفسه، وbeat the price تعني نقدّم سعرًا أفضل (أقل).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Match a price = offer the same price. Beat a price = offer a better (lower) price.

examples.sentence: We can match their price of £3.

fine_lines.title: rival vs competitor
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى المنافس؛ competitor أكثر استخدامًا في لغة الأعمال الرسمية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean a company you compete with. Competitor is more common in formal business English.

examples.sentence: Our main competitor is Tutti Fruity.
The two rival companies want the same client.

expressions.phrase: I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with our price.
expressions.meaning_ar: يؤسفني أن أسمع أنك غير راضٍ عن سعرنا.
expressions.meaning_en: Show you care about the client's problem.
expressions.example: I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with our price. Let's see what we can do.

expressions.phrase: Our company prides itself on quality products and good value for money.
expressions.meaning_ar: تفتخر شركتنا بمنتجات عالية الجودة وقيمة جيدة مقابل السعر.
expressions.meaning_en: Say what your company is proud of.
expressions.example: Our company prides itself on quality products and good value for money.

expressions.phrase: You are a valued customer and your business is very important to us.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنت عميل نقدّره وتعاملك معنا مهم جدًّا لنا.
expressions.example: You are a valued customer and your business is very important to us.

expressions.phrase: We can match the price of our competitors.
expressions.meaning_en: We can offer the same price as other companies.
expressions.example: Don't worry. We can match the price of our competitors.

expressions.phrase: Hopefully we can sort something out.
expressions.example: I understand the problem. Hopefully we can sort something out.

expressions.phrase: Please let me know as soon as you can.
expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلك أبلغني في أقرب وقت ممكن.
expressions.example: Please let me know as soon as you can, because the offer ends Friday.

expressions.phrase: I will have to have a think about this.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأحتاج إلى التفكير في هذا الأمر.
expressions.example: It's a good offer, but I will have to have a think about this.

grammar.title: I'm sorry to hear (that)...
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم I'm sorry to hear (that) + جملة لإظهار التعاطف مع مشكلة العميل قبل تقديم الحل.
grammar.explanation_en: Use I'm sorry to hear (that) + clause to show you care about a problem before offering a solution.
examples: I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with our price.
I'm sorry to hear that the delivery was late.
I'm sorry to hear about the problem.

grammar.title: pride oneself on + noun / -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: التركيب: subject + pride(s) + ضمير انعكاسي (ourselves/itself) + on + اسم أو فعل بـ -ing. الشركة مفرد فنقول prides itself.
grammar.explanation_en: Pattern: subject + pride(s) + reflexive pronoun + on + noun or -ing. A company is singular: it prides itself on...
examples: Tip Top Trading prides itself on quality.
We pride ourselves on good service.
She prides herself on being on time.

questions.question: "We can match the price" means we can offer...
questions.explanation_ar: match the price تعني نقدّم السعر نفسه.

questions.question: I'm sorry to ___ you're not happy with our price.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح I'm sorry to hear.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is I'm sorry to hear.

questions.question: Our company prides ___ on quality products.
questions.explanation_ar: company مفرد غير عاقل فنستخدم itself.

questions.question: We pride ourselves ___ good service.
questions.explanation_ar: حرف الجر الصحيح مع pride oneself هو on.

questions.question: "Value for money" means...
questions.explanation_en: Good quality for the price you pay.

questions.question: What discount did Anna offer the client?
To sell at a lower price than a competitor is to...
questions.explanation_ar: undercut تعني البيع بسعر أقل من المنافس.
questions.explanation_en: Undercut = sell cheaper than a competitor.

questions.question: Which sentence makes a client feel important?
questions.explanation_ar: You are a valued customer تُشعر العميل بأهميته.
questions.explanation_en: It shows the client is important.
